Never Have I Ever: couple edition

Confessions, couple edition: “Never have I ever pretended to like a gift from you.” Read the card out loud. Whoever has done it owns up and tells the story.

Never Have I Ever1 / 50

Never have I ever pretended to like a gift from you.

Read it out. Whoever has, owns up.

Tip: arrow keys and swiping work too.

How to play

  1. One of you reads the card out loud.
  2. Whoever has done it owns up: raise a hand, take a sip or just be honest.
  3. Now the best part: the story behind it.
  4. Take turns reading until there are no secrets left (or you're tired).
